title: Finite-stage local module objects without transitions
statement: Let $I$ be a directed preorder, $R:I\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ a functor with Noetherian rings $R_k$, and $c$ a limit cone of $R^{\mathrm{op}}\circ\operatorname{Spec}$ with affine vertex $S$. Fix $i\in I$ and a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism $f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. Put $X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S$ and $X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j)$ for $j\geq i$ [def-pc-base-change]. For a finitely presented quasi-coherent module $M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent], there are $j\geq i$, a finite affine open cover $U_a\to X_j$, and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules $N_a$ on $U_a$, each equipped after pullback to $X$ with an isomorphism to the restriction of $M$. No transition maps or compatibility between these isomorphisms are asserted.

source.place: Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR: First proof of Tag 01ZR, finite affine-cover object lifting; object clause of Tag 05N7

proof.text: Quasi-compactness over the affine base gives a compact Xi. Choose the finite subcover V of its affine cover. Apply the single affine-chart object-model lemma separately to each a, obtaining k_a ≥ i, N_a, and the limit comparison.

Choose j bounding the finite set consisting of i and all k_a. Pull V back along the first projection Xj → Xi to give U. Its index type is that of V, hence finite, and its components are affine because the stage base change projection is affine. For each a construct the chart transition g from U_a to its k_a chart by the pullback universal property. Construct the map h between their limit charts by the same universal property. The two projection equations imply that pulling back the old comparison along h gives a comparison for g^*N_a with the restriction of M: compose pullbackComp, pullbackCongr and the image of the old isomorphism. Pullback preserves finite presentation and quasi-coherence. Finally choose and assemble these chart models into the family N.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_local_object_models
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules)
    (hM : M.IsFinitePresentation) (hMq : M.IsQuasicoherent) :
    ∃ (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
      (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u}),
      let p := baseChangeMap f
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
        (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i)))
        (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))
      Finite U.I₀ ∧ (∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)) ∧
      ∃ N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules,
        (∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ (∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom p a)).obj (N a) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((U.pullback₁ p).f a)).obj M))
